parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS multica_review_capability_consumptions (
  jti uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  repo text NOT NULL,
  pr_number bigint NOT NULL,
  head_sha char(40) NOT NULL,
  consumed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL
);
WITH cleanup AS (
  DELETE FROM multica_review_capability_consumptions WHERE expires_at < now() - interval '7 days'
), consumed AS (
  INSERT INTO multica_review_capability_consumptions (jti, repo, pr_number, head_sha, expires_at)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3::bigint, $4, to_timestamp($5::bigint))
  ON CONFLICT (jti) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING jti
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consumed) AS capability_consumed;

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS multica_review_dispatches (
  jti uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  repo text NOT NULL,
  pr_number bigint NOT NULL,
  head_sha char(40) NOT NULL,
  autopilot_id uuid NOT NULL,
  run_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL
);
DELETE FROM multica_review_dispatches WHERE expires_at < now() - interval '7 days';
INSERT INTO multica_review_dispatches (jti, repo, pr_number, head_sha, autopilot_id, run_id, expires_at)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3::bigint, $4, $5::uuid, $6::uuid, to_timestamp($7::bigint))
ON CONFLICT (jti) DO UPDATE SET autopilot_id = EXCLUDED.autopilot_id, run_id = EXCLUDED.run_id, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at;
SELECT repo, pr_number, head_sha, autopilot_id::text, run_id::text FROM multica_review_dispatches WHERE jti = $1::uuid AND expires_at > now();

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://multica.beaco.works/api/autopilots/' + $("Get Multica Review Dispatch").first().json.autopilot_id + '/runs/' + $("Get Multica Review Dispatch").first().json.run_id }}
